# Bootstrap 5.3.8

Unmodified compiled assets, served locally so the application needs no CDN
connection at runtime:

- CSS: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.8/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css
- Bundle (includes Popper): https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.8/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js
- License: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/twbs/bootstrap/v5.3.8/LICENSE

The upstream license is preserved in `LICENSE` and in asset headers.
Optional development source maps are not included.
